meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 它会通读仓库所有未关闭的问题（含评论），按“同一底层缺陷”分组；每组开一个总问题并附设计文档，用统一评论关闭其余子问题；随后每组打包一个修复合并请求，合并时自动关闭该组子问题，最终未关闭的只剩总问题。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 个以上未关闭问题、且不少疑似同一缺陷的重复症状，或当你要求做问题分类/合并/去重、从 open issues 制定计划或路线图、将新 bug 归入现有计划时触发。

say.text: 请按根因把这些未关闭的问题合并成几个计划主问题。
say.note: 触发聚类流程，生成主问题并关闭子问题。

say.text: 这个新报的 bug 能不能并入某个现有计划主问题？
say.note: 触发归类，匹配则并入对应主问题并关闭。

say.text: 把 plan-02 的修复做成一个 PR，关闭它名下的所有子问题。
say.note: 触发打包，PR 合并后自动关闭对应子问题。

howto.what_en: Reads all open issues, comments included; groups by root cause. Per group: opens a plan-master issue and design doc, closes child issues with one standard comment, ships a PR whose merge auto-closes them; final open list is only the masters.
howto.when_en: Use when 20+ open issues share suspected root causes, when asked to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe, to plan/roadmap from issues, or to route a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Please consolidate these open issues into a few plan-master issues by root cause.
say_en.note: Triggers the cluster pass; creates masters and closes children.

say_en.text: Can this new bug be folded into an existing plan master?
say_en.note: Triggers triage; if matched, posts a Round N comment and closes the child.

say_en.text: Turn the fix for plan-02 into one PR that closes all its child issues.
say_en.note: Triggers bundling; merging the PR auto-closes those children.
